segments.name: Manufactured housing
segments.description: Builds, sells and finances manufactured homes and Tiny Houses for affordable-housing buyers, sold through independent retailers, company-owned stores and directly to communities.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from selling manufactured homes and Tiny Houses to retailers, consumers and mobile home parks, plus interest income from financing those sales.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenues through the manufacture and sales of manufactured homes and "Tiny Houses" and the related interest income associated with financing these homes sales.
